ITEM 1 | Off-white cubes, roughly 2–2.5 cm each, firm, matte surface with slightly irregular edges, clustered at upper left of plate, about 8–10 cubes stacked loosely, some with faint pale edges | 120
ITEM 2 | Dark green leafy greens with thin light stems and wilted leaves, mixed with bright green broccoli florets and a few purplish-brown bits, glossy with slight moisture, piled in a mound about 8 cm across at top center | 60
ITEM 3 | Golden-brown roasted potato wedges, about 4–5 cm long and 2 cm thick, skin edges visible, slightly crisp-looking exterior with light browning, three to four pieces grouped at upper right | 130
ITEM 4 | Baked pasta or lasagna-style square, about 7 x 6 cm and 2.5 cm tall, orange-red sauce topped with bubbly, browned melted cheese with darker golden spots, moist and holding shape, sitting center right | 150
ITEM 5 | Grilled eggplant pieces, dark purple-black skin with charred grill marks and lighter cut flesh, chunks about 2–3 cm, slightly glossy, at right edge of plate | 50
ITEM 6 | Mound of pale grainy porridge-like grain (possibly coarse, with visible speckles of darker bits), beige-tan, soft and slightly moist, about 6 x 5 cm and 1.5 cm tall, with a pale cube-like piece beside it, lower left of plate | 110
ITEM 7 | Thin fresh green sprouts or microgreens with small leaves and thin pale stems, scattered in a few strands across the lower left, slightly wilted, very light | 5
